messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the location summary in the IGEA technical sheet, in which municipalities other than Iglesias are lifting devices of the list located?

response.text: Secondo il riepilogo sull'ubicazione presente nella scheda tecnica IGEA, in quali comuni diversi da Iglesias si trovano i dispositivi di sollevamento dell'elenco?
